notes: The two-morpheme unit אֵין חֵקֶר → 'is unsearchable' was re-examined as a flagged large-source unit and retained: the one English word carries both the existential negation and the searching, so rule 30's one-rendering condition is met and no morpheme owns a part of it; the source head is the negation under rules 23 and 50, and the construction-supplied copula joins the whole under rule 20.
The competing reading — אֵין unrepresented beside a חֵקֶר holding 'unsearchable' — is what rule 30 forbids for a morpheme whose sense the ASV has written inside a fused word.
The לְ of לִגְדֻלָּתוֹ is unrepresented under rule 40, the ASV promoting the noun to English subject.
